senses: to delay, hesitate, tarry, defer, remain behind
to cause one to delay, hinder, keep back
(Piel) to delay, wait, stay behind (but not in hope)

strongs.def: to loiter (i.e. be behind); by implication to procrastinate
strongs.kjv: continue, defer, delay, hinder, be late (slack), stay (there), tarry (longer)
